text:
Ava (AE): FYI MediCore just escalated to execs. CISO wants SOC2 attestation + answers to sections 2/3 of the security questionnaire by EOD Tue. CTO also pushed for a private deployment (VPC) and dedicated GPUs — wants timeline and delta vs hosted pricing. Can we triage?
Raj (SE): copying in Ben. Quick Q: private deployment = Redwood Private VPC + reserved capacity or full on-prem?
Ben (SRE): They said private deployment (VPC) + reserved Dedicated pool. We can do Dedicated in their preferred cloud region, need a 2–3 week lead for capacity reservation if we commit now.
Ava (AE): timeline is tight — CTO flagged next Tuesday for internal presentation. Is there any way to accelerate to 7–10 days?
Raj (SE): We can prioritize if legal and billing sign off faster, but provisioning GPUs + networking + KMS integration is the gating path. If they accept temporary hosted with strict egress and KMS placeholders, we can buy time.
Marta (Sales Ops): For pricing: estimate for Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv) + VPC peering + 1yr commit = approx $XXk/month — I can run exact numbers if we lock commit length. What concession range do we have?
Lisa (Legal): I'll need the completed security questionnaire before I can sign the standard Private deployment addendum. Also need MSS (minimal security spec) for KMS BYO. Ava, can you share the SQ PDF link?
Ava (AE): Uploading SQ now: https://files.redwood/mc-sq-2025.pdf — also attaching the list of required SOC2 artifacts they requested. Dr. Chen is expecting point-by-point answers.
Dr. Chen (Customer CISO): To clarify, we need: (1) SOC2 Type II report, (2) encryption at rest with customer-managed keys, (3) network allowlist + private peering, (4) data deletion SLA. Also clarifying that any temporary hosted solution must have no persisted logs beyond 24h.
Ben (SRE): For customer-managed keys we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). Implementation ETA ~3 business days once IAM/KMS permissions are provided. For deletion SLA we can commit to 30 days standard — to meet 24h we'd need additional tooling and ops runbooks, estimate +2 weeks.
Raj (SE): Ops note: we can enable prefix/KV caching disabled to reduce persisted context footprint while hosted. For Dedicated VPC, network setup + peering + routing validation usually 48–72h once we have customer network contacts and firewall rules.
Marta (Sales Ops): Ava, what's the acceptable discount threshold for a 1yr vs 2yr commit? I need to model with finance ASAP.
Ava (AE): Customer asks for 25% off list for 1yr. Is that within threshold or need exec approval?
Marta (Sales Ops): 25% is above our standard AE cap. I'll need manager signoff, and finance wants to see projected commit and usage patterns. Pinged finance.
Lisa (Legal): Also flag: custom data deletion SLA + KMS BYO will require small addendum. I can draft a redline but need exact deletion/replay window requirements.
Raj (SE): Action items from engineering side: 1) Ben to confirm KMS perms + sample key policy, 2) SE to produce config snippet for VPC peering and firewall rules, 3) provide a minimal hosted fallback plan with 24h log retention.
Ben (SRE): I'll send the key policy template and a runbook extract. Snippet: ```aws:kms policy: {"Sid":"AllowRedwood"...}``` — will DM secure copy. ETA 6 hours.
Ava (AE): Can someone call out the blockers we need to remove to meet Tue? I want a one-liner per owner I can bring to CTO.
Raj (SE): Raj: deliver VPC/firewall snippet + hosted fallback config (6h).
Ben (SRE): Ben: KMS policy + ops ETA + deletion SLO proposal (6h).
Marta (Sales Ops): Marta: pricing delta 1yr vs 2yr and exec approval path (4h).
Lisa (Legal): Lisa: draft addendum + redline for deletion/KMS (end of day).
Ava (AE): Thanks. I'll set a 9:30am sync tomorrow with MediCore execs and share the one-liners. If anyone hits blockers please @here. :pray:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary to staging for VPC templates tomorrow 03:00 UTC (no impact).
